causal_edges.explanation: The timeout in the quality check results in incorrect scheduling data being sent to Agent 4.
The incorrect delivery route causes a cascade effect impacting production start times.
Delayed production start leads to pending approval status in quality checks.
Pending approval results in a failed delivery status.

root_cause_explanation: Agent 3 encounters a delay in the quality check process, causing a timeout that is not communicated properly to dependent agents.
